snippet_primary: "The Services enable sellers of digital products ("Suppliers") that have a Supplier Account (as defined below) with Gumroad to appoint Gumroad as such Suppliers' non-exclusive reseller of certain of their digital products that Gumroad deems eligible for resale through the Services ("Digital Products" or "Products")."
subject_exact: Gumroad legal role as non-exclusive reseller of eligible digital products on behalf of sellers
parser_notes: Terms of Service effective 2025-01-01. 'Non-exclusive' and 'deems eligible' qualifiers preserved. Establishes Gumroad's merchant of record legal structure.
